column1: # p495 — the load-bearing prose claims of this KB, each with a grep key that makes a
# DELETION detectable. Registering a claim here is the only way a dropped paragraph
# acquires the property a dropped table row already has: a key somebody can grep.
#   - grep_key must be a DISTINCTIVE LITERAL that no boilerplate would reproduce.
#   - required_file is where the claim must LIVE, not where it is also mentioned.
#   - ARCHIVE-ONLY is a FAILURE: p494's Singapore paragraph was in the tree the whole
#     time, in archive/2026-10-19-p315-pre-rewrite/. A whole-tree grep calls that PRESENT.
#   - Register the claim a pattern or a price DEPENDS ON. Not every fact. This is a
#   - Whitespace in a key is NORMALISED, so a key may cross a line wrap. This KB
#     hard-wraps at ~95 chars; `T15-INTEGRATION-AUTHORITY` was reported CLAIM-LOST
#     on a sentence sitting in the file before the checker was made wrap-tolerant.
#   - p880: `status` is LIVE (default) or RETIRED.  RETIRE a claim this base has
#     REFUTED or superseded, and give retired_by + retired_reason: the gate refuses a
#     retirement that justifies itself with neither.  A RETIRED claim is graded the
#     OTHER WAY ROUND — it must NOT be published — because the base should not assert
#     what its own register records as untrue.  Retiring is for a claim that is WRONG,
#     never for one that is merely inconvenient to carry.

column5: The one instrument worldwide addressing agent autonomy bounds, action logging, human-in-the-loop and multi-agent accountability — the four axes every compose/patterns.md recipe must defend. Deleted by p315's rewrite, unnoticed ~179 passes.

The assurance half of the Singapore programme. A voluntary instrument that functions as a PROCUREMENT GATE for vendors selling to banks and government — the reason SG-AGENTIC-FIRST is a sales asset and not a compliance burden.

Vietnam's Decision 33 makes a RAG tutor over an unvetted corpus high-risk on the retrieval design alone, with no grading feature anywhere in the product. An EU-conformant design has no corpus-provenance artefact to show for it.

The education/health/finance deadline for systems already in operation before 15 Aug 2026. p493 degraded this precise holding into an apparent contradiction; p494 restored it. The conditional is the whole value.
The 16-month slip of the EU high-risk deadline for stand-alone education systems. The entire EMEA engagement window argument rests on this date.

The diagnosis that separates a proxy allowlist refusal from a transient outage. Without it, every pass re-probes arxiv.org and eur-lex.europa.eu and re-files them as "might be cleared next time".
Closes a standing action carried 10+ passes. The Omnibus primary read is a HUMAN deliverable, not a pass backlog item.
The longest-standing declared gap in this KB — 13 passes. An informed gap is information; deleting it looks exactly like coverage.
column8: REFUTED, and by work recorded on the very page it is registered against. p875 filed a European instrument measuring European students directly: 5,000 secondary students aged 13-19 across 10 European countries plus 600 teachers, 79% using AI for homework, 47% shown how; plus a German teacher survey (73%/67%) and QS weekly-use figures (67%/62%). That IS an EMEA adoption rate. Restoring the sentence would have republished a closed gap in order to turn this gate green. The compound claim's surviving half is re-registered as EMEA-VENDOR-RANKING-GAP: splitting it is the point, because closing one half of a compound gap makes the whole row a falsehood while the open half silently disappears.
